images.caption: The Harper House, main dwelling of the Harper family. During the March 1865 Battle of Bentonville in North Carolina it served as a hospital of the Union forces. It has since been restored and is part of the Bentonville Battleground State Historic Site.
images.alt: The Harper House, main dwelling of the Harper family. During the March 1865 Battle of Bentonville in North Carolina it served as a hospital of the Union forces. It has since been restored and is part of the Bentonville Battleground State Historic Site.

images.caption: The Battle of Bentonville took place March 19 - 21, 1865 near Bentonville, North Carolina in Johnston County. It was one of the last battles of the American Civil War. Today it is a North Carolina State Historic Site.
images.alt: The Battle of Bentonville took place March 19 - 21, 1865 near Bentonville, North Carolina in Johnston County. It was one of the last battles of the American Civil War. Today it is a North Carolina State Historic Site.
